meta.title: Antigravity Executor
meta.description: Delegate coding tasks to the signed-in Antigravity desktop agent. Adds an adaptive task mode that picks a surgical engineering persona or a creative visual-density persona per call (with a Pass-1 review gate for 3D and front-end work), so switching task types never needs a config edit. Works in the dsh session directory with a configurable thinking tier, RPC-driven settlement that returns within seconds, an in-process serial queue for parallel tool calls, untruncated long reports, live account quota with 5h and weekly guards plus a 24h floor, a destructive-vs-escape kill switch that cuts .git metadata writes unconditionally, human-like inter-turn pacing, dead-session self-heal with context recovery, a 60s hanging-command circuit breaker, and a git snapshot inlined into every result.
